card.name: Small linking words in formal titles
card.fires_on: Small linking words like of, and, for, or a place name inside capitalized titles or abstract noun phrases in encyclopedic or religious prose. The next word is often a noun like Family, Crafts, or arts.

modes.label: Of/and in titles
modes.description: The word of or and inside a title or institution name, right before the next noun.
modes.example: the Camberwell School of Arts<< and>> Crafts.

modes.label: Linking words in abstract phrases
modes.description: Of, and, or for linking abstract nouns in history or church writing.
modes.example: Christian control of the economy, especially<< of>> the larger domestic and international markets

modes.label: Modifier inside a named field
modes.description: A name or adjective that begins a named institution or field, such as Vienna or fine.
modes.example: admission to the<< Vienna>> Academy of Fine Arts.
